about: Public curated nets from pflow-xyz examples/landing, copied unchanged. pflow_xyz_cid is the @id the file is published under; cid is what this engine seals the net to when loaded (without the file's author attribution, which pflow.xyz keeps outside the sealed document: with it removed 4 of 6 equal the published CID). The composition is derived at load time from bundle_example and bundle_net; its cid is from the local engine.

examples.title: Coffee Shop
examples.description: Weighted arcs encode recipes, conservation laws guarantee you never oversell a latte.
examples.cid_note: The engine seals this document to a different CID than the @id pflow.xyz stores it under (the file is as fetched from pflow.xyz/o/<cid>); the published CID is kept in pflow_xyz_cid and url.

examples.title: Tic-Tac-Toe
examples.description: Every board position is a place. ODE heatmaps reveal optimal play from network topology alone.

examples.title: Enzyme Kinetics
examples.description: Four places, three transitions — mass-action kinetics produce Michaelis-Menten curves automatically.

examples.title: Predator-Prey
examples.description: Lotka-Volterra dynamics — two species, three reactions, and the ODE solver draws the phase portrait.

examples.title: Producer-Consumer
examples.description: Bounded buffer concurrency — capacity constraints prevent overflow, token counts prove correctness.

examples.title: USDC Bridge
examples.description: Cross-chain token flow — IBC to Noble, CCTP burn-and-mint to Base, all as one net.
examples.cid_note: The engine seals this document to a different CID than the @id pflow.xyz stores it under (the file is as fetched from pflow.xyz/o/<cid>); the published CID is kept in pflow_xyz_cid and url.

examples.title: Order flow (composition)
examples.description: bundle_example's default composition, orders + workers + payment joined by three event links, flattened with bundle_net into one net. Its CID is computed locally; it is not a published pflow.xyz net.
